Aisha (CS): Hey team — quick weekly on Acme pilot. Since last rollout we see model mix shift: rdx-3b-q now ~62% of requests (was ~18%). Fallbacks up to 22% (to rdx-3b-fallback). P95 latency +40ms, error rate 0.6% -> 1.8%. Spend ticked +7%. Need triage before renewal touchpoint on Thu.

Marco (Solutions): Do we have prompt set and traffic split by route? Any change in avg tokens?

Tess (Eng-ML): I pulled traces. New quantized bin rolled yesterday. Early signal: KV cache hit rate down ~12% on long chats. Suspect kernel selection + padding behavior. Quick log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T18:02:22Z] model=rdx-3b-q seq=1024 kv_hit=false latency_ms=180 p95_delta=36
[2026-03-15T18:02:23Z] fallback->rdx-3b-fallback reason=timeout
```

Ravi (CS): Customer reporting completions that feel truncated and more timeout fallbacks. Renewal meeting Thu 10am PT — marking as medium risk until mitigations.

Nina (CSM): Noted. Can we put together a short mitigation list I can share with them pre-call? They asked for suggested config changes.

Tess (Eng-ML): Mitigation options (short):
- force-pin rdx-3b-fallback for long-conversation routes (fast, stable).
- adjust kernel selection to favor single-gemm path (lower latency) — requires runtime tweak.
- enable more aggressive prefix/KV caching for this customer's routes (non-invasive).
I'll start with prefix-caching experiment first.

Marco (Solutions): I'll request the sample prompts and the top-10 routes from Acme. @Ravi can you collect route IDs and recent request examples?

Ravi (CS): On it. Will pull per-route token distribution + last 72h traces and send by EOD.
